pull_requests.title: Collaboration Insights: timer subagent + repo snapshot
pull_requests.author: naomi
pull_requests.head: insights/timer-subagent
pull_requests.body: Implements the sketch from the 2026-06-02 retro: a skill declared in CLAUDE.md runs in a subagent on a ~2-min timer, snapshots the live discussion, pushes it to the repo, and searches for similar prior conversations. See PRD 05.

reviews.body: Before we merge: what stops this from becoming surveillance? I want the humility constraint enforced in code, not just documented.
Fair — added a guard: it reports patterns, never ranks individuals, and questions count toward participation. Marcus changed my design for the better here.
The questions-are-participation rule is in the metric now. Approving.

pull_requests.title: Insights metrics: talk-time, Q:A ratio, dissent timing
pull_requests.author: dana
pull_requests.head: insights/metrics
pull_requests.body: Computes the metric contract from PRD 05 over transcripts + chat. Dogfooded on our own Q2 data first — it correctly flags my 66% talk-time in the roadmap review.

reviews.body: Ran it on Q2. The silent-but-engaged flag catches Naomi exactly right — silent in meetings, top contributor in chat.

pull_requests.title: Round-robin facilitation nudge
pull_requests.author: sarah
pull_requests.head: insights/facilitation-nudge
pull_requests.body: When one speaker passes ~40% airtime, the facilitator gets a private nudge to open the floor. Also supports a round-robin mode + async pre-reads so non-verbal thinkers aren't drowned out. Directly aimed at the pattern Naomi named.

reviews.body: I helped design this. The pre-read + round-robin is the first meeting format that fits how I think. Approving happily.
